name: Bartini Bar & Lounge
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: bartinibabylon.com, instagram.com, facebook.com.
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Phone and email are not on the venue's own site; phone (631) 897-0681 is from the Google Maps listing (also Apple Maps and directories). Google shows Sun 2 PM-2 AM while the venue's site says Sun noon-midnight; we used the venue's site. Facebook page is not linked from the website; matched by name and 'Babylon NY'. getNgigs lists a Facebook group (facebook.com/groups/215776448446764) that we did not use. Older domain bartinibar.com no longer loads. All photos on the site are event flyers or under 600 px, so no photos recorded.
hours: Mon-Sat 2 PM-2 AM; Sun noon-midnight (shorter hours on some summer nights)
description: A laid-back neighborhood bar next to the Babylon train station. Local rock and cover bands play most Friday and Saturday nights, with an open mic on Mondays and karaoke on Thursdays.

logo.alt: Bartini A Bar & Lounge logo: gold letters on a navy art-deco badge with a martini olive on a pick

evidence.note: Venue's own site gives 124 North Carll Ave next to the Babylon train station, regular hours (Mon-Sat 2 PM-2 AM, Sun noon-midnight) and weekend live bands.
Event calendar lists live bands on Friday and Saturday nights through November, Monday open mic and Thursday karaoke.
Google Maps listing 'Bartini Bar & Lounge' (Bar): 124 N Carll Ave, Babylon, NY 11702, phone (631) 897-0681, website bartinibabylon.com.
Instagram bio describes a dive bar and live music venue in Babylon Village at 124 North Carll.
Facebook page titled 'Bartini Bar | Babylon NY'; also listed as the bar's Facebook on artistandfan.com.
